# DoorLine Manufacturers

DoorLine Manufacturers is a professional aluminium handles manufacturer based in Lahore, Pakistan.

- Products: aluminium door handles (fluted bar handles, pull handles, sliding door handles), cabinet handles, window crescent locks and lever locks, aluminium hinges, handle fitting parts.
- Services: aluminium anodizing and electroplating (bulk and job work).
- Customers: hardware shops, aluminium and glass fabricators, dealers, furniture makers and contractors.
- Pricing: direct factory rates, no middleman, wholesale price. Premium quality.
- Delivery: all over Pakistan by transport and cargo.
- Website: https://www.doorlinemanufacturers.com
- Contact person: Abdul Waheed. Phone: 0302 4888180. WhatsApp: 0345 4880180.
